quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #23
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: A red flashing traffic light means the same thing as a:
questions.explanation: A red flashing traffic light means the same as a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop and then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: Your vehicle's accelerator gets stuck while driving on a busy street. What should you do?

options.text: Turn off the ignition carefully without locking the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off the ignition carefully without locking the steering wheel.
questions.explanation: If your accelerator sticks, the engine will keep running even if you lift your foot off the gas. Turn off the ignition gently to stop the engine without locking the steering wheel. Then apply the brakes and move to a safe area.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a winding road with multiple curves is ahead.

questions.question: The traffic light turns yellow as you approach an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Treat it like a caution sign and continue through.
Stop before entering, unless you cannot stop safely.
Speed up to get through before the red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering, unless you cannot stop safely.
questions.explanation: When a yellow light appears, slow down and stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are too close to stop, drive carefully through the intersection.

questions.question: What is the most common color of warning signs?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn drivers of unexpected conditions ahead.

questions.question: Can you cross a double solid yellow line to pass another vehicle?

options.text: Only if there is no oncoming traffic.
Only if the vehicle ahead is driving below the speed limit.

questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean neither direction can cross them to pass. You can only cross these lines when turning into a driveway or business entrance.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the pavement is wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or turns, and increase distance between your vehicle and others.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed from either direction.
Passing is allowed from the side with the broken line.
Passing is allowed from the side with the solid line.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed from the side with the broken line.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means passing is allowed only from the lane on the broken line side.

questions.question: Why should drivers be extra alert to motorcyclists, bicyclists, and pedestrians?

options.text: They are hard to see in traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are hard to see in traffic.
questions.explanation: Many accidents happen because drivers look but do not see motorcycles, bicycles, or pedestrians. They are smaller and harder to spot than cars. Stay alert to protect these vulnerable road users.

questions.question: You want to back out of your driveway and see children playing nearby. What should you do first?

options.text: Rev your engine to warn the children.
Honk your horn so children can hear you.
Walk to the back of your car to check if the way is clear.
Tell the children to stay away.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk to the back of your car to check if the way is clear.
questions.explanation: Always get out and look behind your vehicle before backing up. Do not rely only on mirrors, especially when children are nearby. Check the area thoroughly before moving.

questions.question: When should drivers use hand-to-hand steering?

options.text: When turning the steering wheel during normal driving
When backing up or using controls like turn signals, the radio, or windshield wipers

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning the steering wheel during normal driving
questions.explanation: Use hand-to-hand steering when turning the steering wheel during normal driving. This is also called push-pull steering.

questions.question: What does a single broken white line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is allowed when safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A dashed line means drivers can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What are crosswalks?

options.text: Always marked with horizontal lines on the pavement
Always marked with vertical lines on the pavement

questions.explanation: Crosswalks can be marked or unmarked. You must stop behind crosswalks to let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What do round signs indicate?
questions.explanation: Round signs warn you of a railroad crossing. Use extra caution when you see this sign.

questions.question: What do regulatory signs do?

options.text: Are placed everywhere there is danger
Tell you what you must or must not do
Are diamond-shaped and yellow or green

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell you what you must or must not do
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually rectangular with black text on white background. They tell you what you must or must not do. They show speed limits, passing rules, and other driving laws.

questions.question: An oncoming driver does not dim their high beams. Where should you look?

options.text: At the wheels of the oncoming vehicle
To the right side of the road
To the left side of the road
Down the center of the road

questions.correctAnswerText: To the right side of the road
questions.explanation: Look to the right side of the road. This keeps you from being blinded and lets you see enough to stay on course until the other vehicle passes.

questions.question: When parallel parking between two cars, what should you do first?

options.text: Pull up even with the car in front of the parking space

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull up even with the car in front of the parking space
questions.explanation: After finding a space and signaling, stop next to the car in front of your parking space. Then turn your wheels to park.

questions.question: Passing is not allowed within ____ of a bridge, viaduct, or tunnel.
questions.explanation: Do not pass within 100 feet of a bridge, viaduct, or tunnel. Only pass where other drivers can see you clearly.

questions.question: A driver extends their left arm upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points upward, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: If your car starts to skid, which way should you turn the steering wheel?

options.text: In the direction you want the vehicle to go
In the opposite direction of the skid
It does not matter which direction

questions.correctAnswerText: In the direction you want the vehicle to go
questions.explanation: Turn the steering wheel in the direction you want the vehicle to go. When the vehicle straightens, turn the wheel the other way.

questions.question: A leaking exhaust system can:

options.text: Cause your engine to use too much oil.
Mean you need a tune-up sooner than usual.
Make you feel sleepy while driving.
Start fires on grass along country roads.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make you feel sleepy while driving.
questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes toxic gases and cools hot gases from the engine. Fumes from a leaky exhaust system are very dangerous and can make you drowsy while driving.

questions.question: When you see a steady green arrow on a traffic signal, you:

options.text: Should move into the lane in the direction the arrow points.
Should slow down and stop if it is safe.
May turn in the direction the arrow points after letting other traffic and pedestrians in the intersection go first.
May drive straight through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn in the direction the arrow points after letting other traffic and pedestrians in the intersection go first.
questions.explanation: A green arrow tells you that you may turn in the direction the arrow points. You must be in the correct lane for that turn. Always let other vehicles and pedestrians already in the intersection go first.

questions.question: A fire engine is following you on a two-lane street but is not using its emergency lights or siren. You should:

options.text: Stop as fast as you can.
Speed up to get out of the way.
Slow down, move to the right, and stop.

questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is following you without using its siren or flashing lights, you do not need to move. Drive normally.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which direction they must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: When you get into a car to drive, what should you adjust first?
questions.explanation: First, adjust your seat so you are comfortable and can see the road clearly. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: When you approach an intersection with no traffic signals or stop signs, you should:

options.text: Keep your speed and go through.
Stop, look both ways, then go.
Let all other drivers go first.

questions.explanation: At an uncontrolled intersection, yield to traffic from the right. Always be ready to yield to avoid a crash. Take your foot off the gas, get ready to brake, and look left, right, and left again.

questions.question: You are in the left lane and want to move to the right lane. You should:

options.text: Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your left shoulder for other vehicles.
Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder for other vehicles.
Check your mirrors, signal, and look over both shoulders for other vehicles.
Check your mirrors, signal, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder for other vehicles.
questions.explanation: When changing lanes, look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move to check your blind spot. Always check your mirrors and turn on your signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells drivers that a lane is ending. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: You reach an intersection blocked by traffic ahead. What should you do?

options.text: Get as close as possible to the car in front.
Don't enter the intersection until you can drive all the way through.
Honk your horn to make cars move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Don't enter the intersection until you can drive all the way through.
questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection if traffic is blocked on the other side. Wait until the road ahead is clear so you don't block the intersection.

questions.question: When can you park in the access aisle next to a handicap parking space?

options.text: When you have a handicap plate or placard
When all other spaces are full
When you park for just a few minutes

questions.explanation: You cannot park in an access aisle. Parking there is against the law and you will get a fine.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a hill with a curb, which way should you turn your wheels?
questions.explanation: Turn your wheels sharp away from the curb when parking uphill. This stops your car from rolling into traffic if the brakes fail.

questions.question: When can you pass on the right shoulder of a road?

options.text: When the car in front is driving slowly
When the car in front is turning

questions.explanation: Never drive on the shoulder to pass another car. You can only pass on the shoulder if it is legal and safe, but driving off the road is not allowed.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow light mean?

options.text: Stop, look, then go if there is no traffic
Stop and wait for a green light
Speed up to clear the intersection

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you should slow down and proceed carefully.

questions.question: What is the default speed limit in an urban residential area?
questions.explanation: The speed limit in an urban residential area is 30 mph unless a different speed limit is posted.

questions.question: When a green arrow changes to a solid green light, what can you do?

options.text: You can still turn, but must yield to oncoming traffic
You cannot turn and must go straight
You still have the right to turn
You don't have to turn in the arrow's direction anymore

questions.correctAnswerText: You can still turn, but must yield to oncoming traffic
questions.explanation: When a green arrow becomes a solid green light, you may turn in the direction the arrow was pointing. However, you must yield to oncoming cars and pedestrians.

questions.question: How should you treat railroad crossings?

options.text: As safe—a train is unlikely to come
As places where you must always stop

questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are always dangerous. Always look and listen for trains from both directions. Follow all signs and signals. Only cross when you are sure it is safe.

questions.question: What is the default speed limit in a rural residential area?
questions.explanation: The speed limit in a rural residential area is 35 mph unless a different speed limit is posted.

questions.question: If your vehicle starts to skid, what should you do?

options.text: Turn the wheel too hard the other way
Turn toward the direction of the skid

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn toward the direction of the skid
questions.explanation: Stay calm if your car skids. Steer toward the direction the back of the car is sliding.
